title: Akira Failing in Love Manga Tops 1 Million in Circulation Globally
content: This year's 42nd and 43rd combined issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine announced on September 16 that Shinta Harekawa 's Akira Failing in Love ( Momose Akira no Hatsukoi Hatan-chū ) manga has over 1 million copies in circulation worldwide.
author: ANN

title: Writer Tadashi Agi, Artist Jun Nakanishi's Foodies Manga Ends
content: Kodansha 's Comic Days website posted the final chapter of Tadashi Agi and Jun Nakanishi 's Foodies manga on September 16. The manga's final chapter will become free to read on September 30. The manga launched on Comic Days in August 2025.
author: ANN

content: The Summer 2026 season is also coming to an end, which means three-quarters of the year has already passed, and the majority of the anime that were set to debut on Crunchyroll have already premiered. title: Shūichi Shigeno's Subaru and Subaru Manga Goes on Break Until October 26
content: This year's 43rd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Friday that Shūichi Shigeno 's Subaru and Subaru ( Subaru to Subaru ) manga will take a break and will return in the magazine's 48th issue on October 26.
author: ANN

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Adds Aika Nakamura as New Social Link Character
content: The " Persona 4 Revival Broadcast" livestream revealed on Sunday that Atlus ' Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, will add a new social link character named Aika Nakamura.
author: ANN

title: 'Luca, the Dragon Vet' Manga Ends in 8th Volume
content: Yūna Hirasawa revealed on her X/Twitter account on Friday that her Luca, the Dragon Vet ( Ryūi no Luca , also known as Lucíana, Dragon Veterinarian ) manga will end with the eighth compiled book volume. The series entered its final arc on August 30.
author: ANN

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Shares Season 2 Hopes After Revival’s Crunchyroll Finale
content: A cancelled Shonen Jump series returned this Summer with a new anime revival eight years after it was cut short, and the creator behind it all is hoping for a second season after its big finale.

title: French Publisher Kana's Founder Yves Schlirf Dies
content: French publishing companies Dargaud and Kana announced on September 14 that Kana founder Yves Schlirf died on September 13. Schlirf was also director-general for Dargaud in Belgium, and editorial director at Dargaud Benelux publishing at the time of his death. Schlirf was born in Brussels, Belgium.
author: ANN
